digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local rebar developer gates must be configured to resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles instead of direct Anthropic endpoints
All three local gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must execute end-to-end against Bedrock and produce parseable structured verdicts without degradation
Prompt caching must engage on the Bedrock path with nonzero cache_read_tokens, not write-only behavior
Configuration must be reversible via environment variable with zero provider cross-contamination and documented opt-in/revert in local-dev-env.md
Bedrock cachePoint TTL defaults to 5 minutes matching Anthropic cache_control, so no observable difference in cache lifetime between providers
No changes to infra/ or src/ are required; the change is configuration-only and verified by exit codes on lint, typecheck, and test suites
